description: This source file implements core server management functionalities for a lighttpd server, including signal handling, server creation and cleanup, plugin handling, connection management, instance lifecycle operations, and communication with plugins via angel connections.

classes.name: liServer
classes.description: Represents the server instance, managing event loop, signal handlers, plugins, and server state.

classes.name: liInstance
classes.description: Represents a server instance, including its configuration, process, communication channels, and state management.

classes.name: liInstanceConf
classes.description: Holds configuration for an instance, including command, environment, user info, and resource limits.

classes.name: liInstanceResource
classes.description: Represents resources allocated to an instance, with associated free callback.

methods.name: void sigint_cb(liEventBase * watcher,int events)
methods.description: Handles SIGINT/SIGTERM signals to gracefully stop the server.

methods.name: void sigpipe_cb(liEventBase * watcher,int events)
methods.description: Handles SIGPIPE signals; intentionally ignored in this implementation.

methods.name: liServer * li_server_new(const gchar * module_dir,gboolean module_resident)
methods.description: Creates a new server instance, initializing event loop, signal handlers, and plugins.

methods.name: void li_server_free(liServer * srv)
methods.description: Frees resources associated with a server instance, including plugins and event loop.

methods.name: void li_server_stop(liServer * srv)
methods.description: Stops server operations by stopping signals and plugins.

methods.name: void instance_angel_call_cb(liAngelConnection * acon,const gchar * mod,gsize mod_len,const gchar * action,gsize action_len,gint32 id,GString * data)
methods.description: Handles plugin calls from angel connections, invoking appropriate plugin callbacks.

methods.name: void instance_angel_close_cb(liAngelConnection * acon,GError * err)
methods.description: Handles closure of angel connections, freeing associated resources.

methods.name: void instance_child_cb(liEventBase * watcher,int events)
methods.description: Handles child process exit events, logs and manages instance state accordingly.

methods.name: void instance_spawn_setup(gpointer ctx)
methods.description: Prepares the spawned process environment, especially file descriptors.

methods.name: void instance_spawn(liInstance * i)
methods.description: Spawns a new worker instance and establishes angel connection with communication channels.

methods.name: liInstance * li_server_new_instance(liServer * srv,liInstanceConf * ic)
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new server instance structure.

methods.name: gboolean li_instance_replace(liInstance * oldi,liInstance * newi)
methods.description: Replaces an existing instance with a new one for seamless transition.

methods.name: void li_instance_unset_replace(liInstance * oldi,liInstance * newi)
methods.description: Unsets the replace relationship between old and new instances after replacement.

methods.name: void li_instance_set_state(liInstance * i,liInstanceState s)
methods.description: Transitions an instance to a new state and performs associated actions.

methods.name: void li_instance_state_reached(liInstance * i,liInstanceState s)
methods.description: Handles logic when an instance reaches a specified state, including retries and cleanup.

methods.name: void li_instance_release(liInstance * i)
methods.description: Releases an instance, freeing associated resources and decreasing refcount.

methods.name: void li_instance_acquire(liInstance * i)
methods.description: Increments the reference count for an instance.

methods.name: liInstanceConf * li_instance_conf_new(gchar ** cmd,gchar ** env,GString * username,uid_t uid,gid_t gid,gint64 rlim_core,gint64 rlim_nofile)
methods.description: Creates a new instance configuration object.

methods.name: void li_instance_conf_release(liInstanceConf * ic)
methods.description: Releases resources associated with an instance configuration.

methods.name: void li_instance_conf_acquire(liInstanceConf * ic)
methods.description: Increments the reference count for an instance configuration.

methods.name: void li_instance_add_resource(liInstance * i,liInstanceResource * res,liInstanceResourceFreeCB free_cb,liPlugin * p,gpointer data)
methods.description: Adds a resource to an instance, with a custom free callback.

methods.name: void li_instance_rem_resource(liInstance * i,liInstanceResource * res)
methods.description: Removes a resource from an instance.

ctags.signature: (liAngelConnection * acon,const gchar * mod,gsize mod_len,const gchar * action,gsize action_len,gint32 id,GString * data)
